value_schema.description: Exact DNS query name, including subdomains and underscore labels. Never derive a domain from a company name.

services.name: Public DNS A records
services.description: Retrieve A DNS records for one exact supplied name, including returned CNAME aliases, TTL values, DNS response status, DNSSEC indicator and source URL. One upstream query per purchase; not a whole-zone inventory, ownership check or service availability test.

sample_payload.notice: Public DNS lookup at request time (Google Public DNS). Records describe this exact name and record type, not every record in a DNS zone, company identity, domain ownership, or service availability. Empty records do not establish that a service is unavailable.

coverage.scope: A records for the exact DNS name mollie.com, including returned CNAME aliases
